mapper.select: WITH TEMP AS (SELECT PTL_STGY_ID, PORTFOLIO_ID, MAX(EFF_DATE) EFF_DATE FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO_STGY WHERE EFF_DATE <=#{date,jdbcType=DATE} AND PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID, PTL_STGY_ID ) SELECT PII.INDEX_ID indexId, PII.INCOME_TYPE incomeType, PII.INCOME_TARGET incomeTarget, TEMP.EFF_DATE effDate FROM TEMP INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_EVAL PPE ON PPE.PTL_STGY_ID = TEMP.PTL_STGY_ID AND PPE.EVAL_INDEX = '${EVAL_INDEX_01}' INNER JOIN PTL_INCOME_INDEX PII ON PII.INDEX_ID = PPE.INDEX_ID order by TEMP.EFF_DATE DESC

SELECT PIIF.INDEX_ID indexId, PIIF.COEFFICIENT coefficient, PIIF.SPREAD_RATE spreadRate, Y.INT_RATE intRate FROM PTL_INCOME_INDEX_FLOAT PIIF LEFT JOIN ( SELECT INFO.* FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO INFO INNER JOIN ( SELECT max(EFF_DATE) EFF_DATE,INT_RATE_ID FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO WHERE INT_RATE_ID in ( SELECT BASE_RULE_ID FROM PTL_INCOME_INDEX_FLOAT WHERE INDEX_ID = #{indexId}) AND EFF_DATE <= #{effDate,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY INT_RATE_ID )X ON INFO.EFF_DATE = X.EFF_DATE AND INFO.INT_RATE_ID = X.INT_RATE_ID )Y ON PIIF.BASE_RULE_ID = Y.INT_RATE_ID WHERE PIIF.INDEX_ID = #{indexId}
AND PIIF.LEV = #{level}

SELECT INFO.INT_RATE intRate FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO INFO WHERE INFO.INT_RATE_ID = #{intRateId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND INFO.EFF_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(EFF_DATE) EFF_DATE FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO WHERE EFF_DATE <= #{effDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND INT_RATE_ID = #{intRateId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
